# Review Knowledge

## Purpose

Provide reusable guidance for reviewing changes in a way that finds meaningful risk, improves engineering decisions, and leaves clear actions for authors.

## Scope

This library covers pull-request review and effective review feedback. It complements architecture review and release readiness guidance; it does not replace product ownership or formal risk acceptance.

## When to use

Use before requesting review, while reviewing a change, when responding to findings, and when improving review quality across a team.

## When not to use

Do not use review as a substitute for automated checks, tests, security assessment, or accountable release approval.
